component.name: AstraPlay
component.summary: Free and Open Source Remote Play Client

description.p: AstraPlay is a free, community-built, open source remote play client forked from Chiaki. It focuses on maintaining internet remote play across platforms and aims to keep the app easy to access through major app marketplaces. Supports PlayStation 4 and PlayStation 5 consoles.

screenshot.caption: Browse your game catalog for internet play streaming
Auto-discover and connect to your PlayStation console

description.p: AstraPlay release: complete rebrand with enhanced stability, automated Bak file purging, and cross-platform packaging.
